measures.title: Greene County – Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal): Bridges
measures.summary: Asks whether Greene County may renew a property tax of up to 0.25 mill for 5 years, beginning in 2026 and first due in 2027. The money pays for building, rebuilding, maintaining, resurfacing, repairing or removing bridges in all subdivisions of the county. The county auditor estimates it will collect $1,081,387 a year, or $5 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value.
measures.yesMeans: The 0.25-mill county bridge levy is renewed for 5 years.
measures.noMeans: The bridge levy is not renewed.
